title: Luck Enchantments
description: adds enchantments that give the respective item a chance to drop a rare item when used
body:
## List of enchantments:
- **Kismet:** 
> Weapon enchant that has a 1 in 100,000 to drop a Golden Rotten Flesh when killing entities.
- **Luck of The Potato:** 
> Hoe enchant that has a 1 in 100,000 to drop a Golden Potato when breaking bonemealable blocks.
- **Prosperous Mining:** 
> Pickaxe enchant that has a 1 in 100,000 to drop a Golden Alloy when breaking base stones (overworld and nether), all ores or obsidian.
- **Pristine Lumber:** 
> Axe enchant that has a 1 in 100,000 to drop a Golden Stick when breaking logs.

## What do the golden items do?
Nothing, they are simply a trophy to the fact you got such a rare drop.
